review.rationale: Both plans faithfully select the gated packaged Unreal vertical slice and explicitly defer migration clearance and identity promotion. A is stronger because it separates contract, prerequisite, packaged-boundary, loop, adversarial verification, and evidence review into clearer gates; specifies authority, resource ceilings, evidence integrity, diagnostic allowances, and presentation-boundary proof more completely; and maps unresolved assumptions to concrete probes without implying authorization. B remains highly faithful and actionable but compresses packaging feasibility into the availability gate, provides less explicit evidence-governance and resource-control detail, and leaves slightly more reconstruction around approvals, review disposition, and phase boundaries.
